endpoints.desc: Retrieves the active hardware governor optimization settings including Flash Attention, KV-Cache quantization, memory lock, and safety buffers.

examples.title: Node.js

endpoints.desc: Dynamically updates the Hardware Governor optimization controls in real-time without restarting the engine.

params.name: force_memory_lock
params.desc: Lock process in RAM / mlock to prevent swap lag ('auto', 'on', 'off').

params.name: custom_vram_buffer_gb
params.desc: VRAM safety buffer floor override in gigabytes (null for dynamic auto).

params.name: custom_ram_buffer_gb
params.desc: CPU RAM safety buffer floor override in gigabytes (null for dynamic auto).

examples.title: Python
examples.code:
import requests

payload = {"flash_attention": "on", "kv_cache_quantization": "auto"}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/optimization/update', json=payload)
print(res.json())
